title: serve influencer filter vocabularies from /app only
acceptance: GET /app/influencers/filter-options returns category, country, gender and age-group vocabularies
the route appears in openapi.generated.json under /app/influencers/filter-options and no /v1/influencers/filter-options entry exists
categories are derived from the JSON-encoded creator_tags column and ordered by descending creator count
countries are returned as ISO codes with counts, not as display names
the age-group vocabulary contains exactly the six supported buckets and excludes the overlapping data-quality values
every vocabulary query is scoped to profile_type 'creator' so counts match the list route
each vocabulary query is executed through the read-only ClickHouse MCP and its row counts recorded in the phase notes
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run influencer-filter-options
notes: app surface only, per the requester's decision and the athletes precedent. The list route's filter parameters remain the developer-API entry point. Vocabularies executed through the read-only ClickHouse MCP on 2026-08-11 (ClickHouse 26.2.1.558), each scoped through the same creator CTE the list route uses: categories 53, countries 209, genders 3, age groups 6 (the allowed set only). The category vocabulary reports Music 59,381, matching the list route's categories=[Music] total exactly — which is what proves the scoping agrees. No smoke_cmd: query verification belongs to the MCP, not a committed runner.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/api/src/modules/influencers/routes/influencer-filter-options/influencer-filter-options.smoke.ts:37 — `expect(rows.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)` runs for all four vocabularies, asserting warehouse population rather than acceptance+shape (learned rule: 'a smoke case asserts acceptance and row shape, never warehouse population'); the ageGroupVocabulary variant is especially population-coupled since it filters to allowed buckets — drop the count assertion and keep only `assertOptionShape`.
- apps/api/src/modules/influencers/routes/list-influencers/schemas.ts:28 — exporting `AgeGroupSchema` touches the list route's schemas, which the phase's 'out of scope' forbids, while its Notes require importing the allowed set; the export is the minimal non-behavioral reconciliation, but confirm this was the intended resolution rather than restating the six buckets locally.

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- Low: option collation (`toSorted` by count desc then localeCompare) and the local `FilterOption` interface are duplicated across influencer + athlete + artist filter-options mappers — centralize once a fourth consumer appears.
- Low: category query uses `rawAs(...,"value")` for its alias while country/gender/age use inline `"col AS value"` strings — pick one aliasing idiom for consistency.
